messages:
julia: FYI — Acme CFO coming at 3pm for a quick 30m sync. Do we have a guest badge for them and somewhere to seat them? Also tracking shows a package 'MACBOOK PRO' for 'Acme' arriving today. @sarah_peopleops @mike_office

sarah_peopleops: Got it. I can prep a temp badge. Do we want 'visitor' access only or wifi+guest printing? :thinking_face:

mike_office: 6A is free — I'll reserve the bench and put a 'Reserved for Guest' sign. Anyone object? :raised_back_of_hand:

tom_security: Security prefers escort to meeting room. If they're staying near 6A ok, front desk can badge them in and we can do a quick escort. Need full name + company.

julia: Name is Dana Ruiz, Acme. They'll drop by ~3pm. Short meeting in 6A if that's fine.

eli_mailroom: Mailroom update: package says 'Acme / Dana R' — arrived UPS 10:12. Left at mailroom shelf B3. I'll bring it to Front Desk if you want it earlier. Tracking: `1ZABC12345US`

frontdesk-bot: FrontDesk: Visitor pre-registered for Julia — Dana Ruiz from Acme, expected 15:00. Badge pre-created. Please confirm escort instructions.

sarah_peopleops: Thanks — I'll attach temporary badge to front desk with 'Dana R' and print a visitor guide. Wifi: guest-net / password on the badge card. I'll add note for printing disabled.

mike_office: I'll put the sign and a charger. If they need a monitor adapter tell me.

julia: Can someone grab the package and leave it at the front desk under Dana's name? @eli_mailroom

eli_mailroom: Yep will drop at FD in 10m. If not claimed I'll mark delivered to Julia.

tom_security: :thumbsup: I'll meet them at Reception at 3:00 for escort.

mike_office: :smile: all set. Thanks team!
